title: The rear window
logline: The Legacy from behind on 101, and in its rear window the back of a head and, beside it, the pup's head, both looking forward, the road ahead through the windshield beyond. Two backs of heads in a rectangle of glass.

panels.composition: A faded green station wagon from behind on a coastal highway, its rear window showing the back of a graying man's head and a small dog's head beside it, the road ahead visible through the windshield beyond.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a faded green station wagon seen from behind on a coastal highway with its rear window showing the back of a graying man's head and a small dog's head beside it and the road ahead through the windshield, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring

notes: Two backs of heads in glass.
